argv.notes: --session-id dictated at spawn is the chopsticks/spaghetti join contract; --settings carries the generated hooks; --resume continues a session in place (never combined with --session-id).

hook.notes: Loopback bridge + bearer token interpolated via allowedEnvVars (token value never written to settings). Command transport is a curl forwarder relaying stdin JSON to the same bridge (DESIGN section 16.4 hybrid bridge).

transcript.notes: ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl; path arrives on every hook envelope as transcript_path. Tailed via spaghetti SDK watchSessionTranscript - no second parser. Authoritative for message content; hooks stay authoritative for lifecycle.

statusline.notes: Claude invokes the configured statusLine command with session JSON on stdin; carries rate_limits/usage data (src/statusline.ts).

terminal.notes: The native TUI. Guarded bracketed paste for prompt injection (DESIGN section 17); semantics are never derived from terminal text (ADR-003).
